# AI Library

**AI Library** is a community-maintained knowledge base for artificial intelligence. It brings together foundations, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, safety, applications, and career guidance in one structured repository, published at [artificialintelligencelibrary.com](https://www.artificialintelligencelibrary.com).

## What’s in this repository

The AI Library is organized into categories covering different areas of artificial intelligence, including:

| Section | Focus |
|--------|--------|
| [Foundation](../foundation/index.md) | Math, theory, history, and the ideas behind learning systems |
| [Machine Learning](../machine-learning/index.md) | Classical methods, evaluation, and the modeling workflow |
| [Deep Learning](../deep-learning/index.md) | Neural networks, architectures, and training |
| [Generative AI](../generative-ai/index.md) | LLMs, diffusion models, and agentic systems |
| [Safety](../safety/index.md) | Alignment, fairness, interpretability, and governance |
| [Applications](../applications/index.md) | Domains, use-cases, and MLOps |
| [Career](../career/index.md) | Roles, skills, and professional growth |

## Use it locally

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Artificial-intelligence-Courses/Artificial-intelligence-Library.git
cd Artificial-intelligence-Library
```

Browse the markdown files in your editor or feed them into your own static site pipeline.

## Contribute

- **[Collaboration Wiki](https://github.com/Artificial-intelligence-Courses/Artificial-intelligence-Library/wiki)** — how to propose and submit content, style expectations, and review flow.
- **Issues** — use the templates under `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` for bugs, content requests, or wiki changes.
